tools.name: Workflow cleanup
tools.summary: Prune completed GitHub Actions runs and optionally remove unused, unprotected branches.

entrypoints.usage: Actions → Clean workflows → Run workflow; separately confirm run cleanup and branch cleanup.

tools.name: Dataset analysis
tools.summary: Profile CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, NDJSON, XLSX, or XLS data with missingness, statistics, correlations, plots, and optional exploratory OLS.

entrypoints.usage: Actions → Dataset analysis → Run workflow; enter an existing repository file path under data/.

tools.name: Archive and image pipeline
tools.summary: Create, extend, safely extract, and verify ZIP archives; convert images to PDF.

entrypoints.usage: python scripts/sandbox_file_pipeline.py --help; Pillow is needed only for the pdf command.

tools.name: File export and handoff
tools.summary: Copy files from data/ unchanged, verify SHA-256, and validate DOCX packages before handoff.

entrypoints.usage: Actions → Library file handoff → Run workflow; select one file under data/ and download the one-day artifact.

tools.name: Tool discovery
tools.summary: Search grouped tool capabilities by name, purpose, tags, aliases, or entrypoint path.

entrypoints.usage: python scripts/find_tool.py "csv excel" [--kind script|workflow] [--tag tag] [--format json]
Actions → Tool lookup → Run workflow; filter by query, kind, tags, and output format.
